'''Farruz''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stenax]] with numerous hieroglyphs carved into its walls. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], all that was left of the the city was ruins.
